style: Cozy 16-bit Japanese retro adventure game pixel art (GBA / Eastward aesthetic). Warm dark espresso-brown outlines (#241712), never pure black. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, clean 3-tone cel shading, every pixel clearly visible. NO text, NO watermark, NO UI, NO blur.
green: Single character centred on a FLAT SOLID BRIGHT CHROMA GREEN (#00FF00) background, zero shadows, zero floor, zero props except the ones described. Full body visible with empty green margin.

ojiisan.character: The SAME elderly Japanese grandfather as in the reference images: white hair tied in a small topknot, bushy white eyebrows, kind wrinkled face, brown patched quilted hanten jacket over a dark navy kimono, blue-and-white tenugui cloth tied at the neck, dark work trousers, straw sandals. Keep his face, hair, outfit colours and proportions identical to the references.
ojiisan.references_note: Reference 1: his expression sheet (identity). Reference 2: his full-body walk sheet (outfit and body proportions). Reference 3: a background of this story (match its pixel art style, outline colour and shading warmth, but do NOT draw the background).

base.weave: Pose: he sits on his knees (seiza) on the floor, three-quarter view facing RIGHT, weaving a half-finished golden straw sugegasa hat that rests on his lap; both hands hold straw strands, head tilted down looking at his work with a gentle focused smile.
base.place_hat: Pose: he stands, side view facing RIGHT, both arms raised forward at shoulder height holding a golden straw sugegasa hat with both hands, as if gently placing it on the head of a small stone statue in front of him; kind tender expression.
base.stand: Pose: he stands upright, side view facing RIGHT, hands relaxed at his sides, calm gentle smile.

weave_b: Edit this image. Keep EVERYTHING pixel-identical (face, eyes, hair, body, jacket, colours, position, background) EXCEPT his two hands and the straw strands: move his right hand outward, pulling a straw strand tight, the left hand holding the hat brim. Only the hands region may change.
place_hat_b: Edit this image. Keep his head, face, body, legs and colours pixel-identical and in the same position. Change ONLY his arms and the hat: arms lowered and stretched further forward, the hat now held lower at chest height, as if it has just been set down. Background stays flat #00FF00.
bow: Edit this image. Same character, same outfit, same colours, same feet position and same size. Change his pose to a polite Japanese bow (ojigi): upper body bent forward about 35 degrees from the hips, hands placed on the front of his thighs, eyes looking down. Background stays flat #00FF00.

obaasan.character: The SAME elderly Japanese grandmother as in the reference sheet: silver-white hair combed back into a low round bun at the nape, kind dark eyes, soft rosy cheeks, gentle wrinkles, a terracotta-red quilted winter kimono with a cream inner collar, a long beige-brown work apron tied over it, a dark brown lower kimono, white tabi socks and straw zori sandals. She is about as tall as her husband in reference 2 and drawn at EXACTLY the same pixel size, outline colour and shading as him. Keep her face, hair, outfit colours and proportions identical to reference 1.
obaasan.references_note: Reference 1: her expression sheet (identity, outfit colours). Reference 2: a full-body pose of her husband (match its pixel size, chunky pixel clusters, outline colour, shading and body proportions exactly; do NOT draw him). Reference 3: a background of this story (match its warm palette, but do NOT draw the background).

base.see_off: Pose: she stands in a doorway pose, side view facing LEFT, her right hand raised high and open, waving goodbye, the other hand resting on her apron; a warm caring smile, eyes open, as if saying 'itterasshaimase' to her husband walking out into the snow.
base.pour_tea: Pose: she sits on her knees (seiza) on the floor, three-quarter view facing LEFT, holding a small black iron teapot by its handle in her right hand above a small round teacup that she holds in her left hand in front of her knees; the teapot is level (not pouring yet); a soft welcoming smile.
base.peek: Pose: she stands, side view facing LEFT, leaning slightly forward as if peeking out of a paper shoji window, her left hand raised beside her ear to listen, the right hand touching her chin; curious, attentive expression.
base.thanks: Pose: she stands, side view facing LEFT, both palms pressed together in front of her chest in a gesture of prayerful thanks (gassho), head bowed slightly, eyes gently closed, a grateful smile.

pour_tea_b: Edit this image. Only the teapot, the hand and the tea stream may change.
